description: SymmetricEigen 4..6, SVD / rank / pseudo-inverse / polar of every shape, QR of the remaining shapes, Cholesky updates, wilkinson_shift (WP 8.5-P14b)

format.tolerance_unit: raw units (1 ulp = 2^-32), applies to every output scalar

ops.name: symmetric_eigen4_eigenvalues
ops.doc: a.symmetric_eigen().eigenvalues sorted ASCENDING, symmetric matrices, independent entries mirrored (check the eigenvectors by reconstruction)
ops.tolerance: ceil(8 + 16 * A + 16 * max |input|), A = max over outputs of sum over inputs of |d out / d in| (central differences)
